svg.aria-label: The loop the nine rubric dimensions describe: a versioned golden set feeds an eval run graded by deterministic graders and an independent judge; the eval run feeds a regression gate; a version the gate passes ships to production, where guardrails, traces, cost caps and the scale signal apply; production traces feed a diagnosis that proposes the next version back into the eval run, and a version the gate refuses goes to diagnosis instead of to users.
svg.text: R1–R4 · the learning half · R5–R9 · the operating half

g.title: R1 — a versioned golden set: fixed cases, committed predictions, reproducible offline
The eval run — deterministic graders plus an LLM judge that is independent of the model being graded (R1, R2)
R3 — the regression gate: an eval floor and no per-case pass to fail flips
R8 — merge is the deploy: keyless OIDC CI/CD with a smoke test and a rollback path
Production — guardrails around every action (R5), a trace per request (R6), cost per answer and its caps (R7), and the saturation signal that says when to move up the ladder (R9)
R4 — the learning loop: diagnose the traces, propose one lever, verify it against the golden set before it can ship

path.title: traces and the judged online sample come back from production
the proposed next version is re-evaluated before it can ship
a version the gate refuses goes back to diagnosis, not to users

svg.text: a version the gate refuses goes back to diagnose, never to users
